description: One global chart of accounts in the core (Step 0, blueprint 42 A). The double-entry journal is a projection of the event log at every tier: tiers decide which reports are shown, never what is recorded. A country that requires its own chart gets it as a country-pack mapping (`chart_of_accounts` in the pack: global code to the local code and name); the global codes are what every service, export and test use. Shared by every language, like the other contract files.

1010.name: Electronic payments clearing
1010.note: mobile money, card, QR and transfers between the sale and the provider's confirmation; the payout clears it

4100.name: Commission income
4100.note: the agent's commission, posted only from the cloud's CommissionRecorded event

6200.name: Cash differences
6200.note: a shortfall is a debit, a surplus a credit; flagged to the owner, never hidden

postings.description: Event type to balanced journal lines. `amount` names the payload field (default total_minor); `by_method` picks the debit account from the payment method. Events not listed post nothing (they are not money facts).
